svg.title: The driven dynamical system from mono audio to membrane modes, mirror pose, and laser coordinates on the wall.

svg.data-tex: \text{For fixed settings, twelve states store six displacements and six velocities.}
\text{Each mode is a vibration pattern. The input is not calibrated pressure.}
\textbf{2. The membrane sets the mirror pose.}
\text{A plane fit over the mirror's circular footprint gives fixed weights.}
\text{A ray that misses the mirror or wall gives no point.}
\text{Each audio sample advances the state. We ignore light travel time.}
\text{Asymmetry changes the mode coupling and resonance frequencies.}
\text{From rest, zero asymmetry gives no centred-mirror tilt.}
\text{One input drives both outputs. Some target paths may be unreachable.}
